about: Made by crates/engine/src/plugins/vectors from the engine's own constants; the edge imports it. max_manifest_bytes is the manifest's canonical JSON without its signature; max_manifest_json_bytes and max_manifest_values are the manifest as written in the package, signature included, every JSON value counted once (keys not); max_publish_body_bytes is the .zeron-plugin file as uploaded. reserved_ids are the manifest rule's: ids Zeron itself won't run ('Zeron already uses that name', the manifests cases' id_error). site_ids are the store site's own pages beside /plugins/<id>: a device runs a plugin with one, but the store never lists it (the listing rule id_reserved, which no reservation lifts). The cases that hold both sides to these rules are in docs/plugin-package-vectors.json.

consent.about: A program's name is lowercased and loses one Windows extension (windows_extensions) before it's looked up. It can do anything you can unless it's in contained. It gives full control when it's in full_control, as it is or with its trailing digits and dots taken off (python3.12 → python). commands_anything is every program that can do anything you can and is neither full_control nor held_to_its_own_rules. A host is local when it's localhost, a private or loopback address, ends .localhost .local .internal .lan .home.arpa .intranet .corp, has one label, or ends in a number (decimal or 0x hex); network_local is every host but * that is local, network_named every host that names one host exactly (not * or *.…) and isn't local.

mark_claims.about: A listing's name or description may not claim the store's mark (amendment 45; bad_listing on that field). The text is read as Unicode NFKC, lowercased (full Unicode lowercase, as JavaScript's toLowerCase), then NFKD with every nonspacing mark (General Category Mn) dropped; it claims the mark when it has any of glyphs anywhere, or any of words as a whole word: an occurrence with no ASCII letter or digit right before or after it. The listing cases named 'the mark' hold both sides to it. The edge also reads the name and description through its confusables skeleton before the word check, which a device does not: the cases marked '(edge only)' carry edge_problems, the edge's answer, where problems is the device's.

newer_rule: A store version is newer by SemVer 2.0.0 precedence, build metadata ignored: equal precedence is the same version. A publish must be later than every version the plugin has had, in any state, pre-releases included.
